categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the development, production, and sales of testing and measuring instruments and meters. Its product lines include general instruments, professional instruments, temperature and environmental testing instruments, and testing instruments. The company also engages in ODM services and e-commerce sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced safety protection, high-efficiency sampling and digital signal processing, automatic calibration, stable and fast voltage boosting, and specialized algorithms for infrared thermal imaging and signal analysis. The company employs proprietary chip development for oscilloscope front-end modules and integrates AI-driven image processing algorithms. Production is carried out in modern manufacturing bases in Dongguan, Heyuan, and Vietnam, with a mix of make-to-stock and make-to-order models.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span wireless communications, automotive electronics, semiconductor chips, aerospace, scientific research, certification testing, new energy, and power supply industries. The company serves both domestic and international distributors, ODM clients mainly in Europe and America, and end-users in industrial, educational, and research sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations cover domestic China with offices in major economic cities and overseas markets including Europe, America, Hong Kong, and Vietnam. The company has subsidiaries and production bases in these regions, supporting a global sales network across over 80 countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and sales of testing instruments. It sources key components like ICs, PCBs, and sensors from multiple suppliers and delivers finished products to distributors and end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include increasing R&D investment to drive innovation in high-end instruments such as high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, RF signal analyzers, power supplies, and infrared thermal imagers. The company emphasizes core component self-control, AI integration in signal and image processing, and expansion of product lines for power, new energy, and industrial applications. It also fosters industry-academia collaborations and global marketing network expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of self-branded instruments and ODM manufacturing services. Sales channels include domestic and international distributors, direct e-commerce platforms, and ODM contracts with major global brands. The company also earns investment income from financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global leaders like Fluke and Keysight Technologies. It positions itself as a leading domestic brand with a comprehensive product portfolio covering multiple instrument categories. It holds a strong market presence in China and is expanding internationally with competitive technology and cost advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.13 billion, a 10.81% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 183.4 million, up 13.64%. R&D investment accounted for over 10% of revenue. The company has steadily grown its asset base and expanded production capacity, including a new Vietnam facility.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, high-safety, high-reliability, and cost-effective testing instruments with advanced technological features such as high-resolution oscilloscopes, AI-enhanced thermal imaging, and specialized professional meters for power and new energy sectors. Its broad product matrix, strong R&D capabilities, and localized global service network differentiate it in the market.
